rules.source: Personal Data Act 2018 (LOV-2018-06-15-38) — implements GDPR in Norway via the EEA Agreement (incorporated 6 July 2018); enforced by Datatilsynet (the Norwegian Data Protection Authority) under GDPR Article 51. Official text: lovdata.no.

Personal Data Act 2018 (LOV-2018-06-15-38) — sets Norway's national age of consent for children's data processing at 13 years (lower than the EU GDPR Article 8 default of 16), one of the national-flexibility provisions GDPR permits member/EEA states to set themselves. Official text: lovdata.no.
Lov om straff (straffeloven) LOV-2005-05-20-28, § 204 Innbrudd i datasystem — https://lovdata.no/dokument/NL/lov/2005-05-20-28/§204
rules.retrieved_snippet: Page heading '§ 204. Innbrudd i datasystem'; text: 'Med bot eller fengsel inntil 2 år straffes den som ved å bryte en beskyttelse eller ved annen uberettiget fremgangsmåte skaffer seg tilgang til datasystem eller del av det.'

rules.source: Lov om straff (straffeloven) LOV-2005-05-20-28, § 185 Hatefulle ytringer — https://lovdata.no/dokument/NL/lov/2005-05-20-28/§185
rules.retrieved_snippet: Page heading '§ 185. Hatefulle ytringer'; opens 'Med bot eller fengsel inntil 3 år straffes den som forsettlig eller grovt uaktsomt offentlig setter frem…' a discriminatory or hateful statement; a separate offence covers such statements made to a targeted person in the presence of others (1 year max).

rules.source: Lov om tiltak mot hvitvasking og terrorfinansiering (hvitvaskingsloven) LOV-2018-06-01-23, in force 15 Oct 2018 — https://lovdata.no/dokument/NL/lov/2018-06-01-23
